text:
nora_collections: FYI HarborWare (acct HBR-7812) bounced a card on invoice #7812 ($62,400) due 2026-02-28. We attempted 3 retries, then chargeback flagged today. Customer reached out asking for a settlement offer and to avoid a collections letter. Thoughts? @han_fin @evan_sales

billing-bot: Automated: 3 failed card attempts recorded; dispute opened 2026-03-18. Invoice status: past_due -> disputed.

han_fin: Oof. What's the dispute reason? Do we have PO or signed SOW? Need invoice docs and evidence to fight chargeback if they contest. If they want a settlement, propose 60% of outstanding if paid within 7 days? But need sales sign-off for strategic accounts.

evan_sales: HarborWare is onboarding our enterprise connector next month. Sales prefers a softer approach. Suggest: short-term hold on escalation if they pay 30% now and sign a revised payment schedule for remaining balance. We can require a corporate guarantee.

sara-cs: They messaged CS: cashflow issue after a delayed VC tranche. They offered a bank confirmation they expect funds in 10 days. Happy to share the convo screenshot.

han_fin: I'm ok with conditional hold if: 1) evidence of incoming funds OR card reauthorization for at least 30% posted within 72 hours, 2) signed payment agreement with retention clause, 3) admin fee 1.5% applied. If any of these fail we forward to collections and revoke product access.

nora_collections: Proposed plan from collection side: Option 1 (fast settle): 60% lump sum ($37,440) due within 7 days, waive late fees and close. Option 2 (installments): 4-month plan: 30% now ($18,720), then 3x equal monthly payments $14,560 each starting 2026-05-01; 1.5% admin fee added. Customer indicated preference for Option 2.

evan_sales: Can we accept Option 2 with the condition that integration work pauses if any payment misses schedule? They will agree to a PO amendment. Sales will hold escalation if legal approves the wording.

legal-ops: I can draft a short addendum and a payment agreement. Need invoice copy, order ID, and the exact pause-of-services clause. Also recommend adding a clause that a missed payment >7 days triggers immediate collections and forfeiture of any discounts.

billing-bot: Note: dispute remains open until chargeback is resolved. If settlement payment posts, bill team please mark dispute withdrawn in the portal.

han_fin: Approving Option 2 conditionally. Requirements: signed addendum + proof of 30% payment by 2026-03-22 23:59 UTC, admin fee confirmed, and sales to submit PO amendment to billing. If those met, remove from active dunning and cancel chargeback escalation.

nora_collections: I'll prepare the addendum and payment link now, send to customer secure email. Also requesting sales to get PO amendment by EOD. Tagging @evan_sales to confirm he will obtain PO.

evan_sales: On it. I'll ping their CFO and get the PO routed today.

sara-cs: Customer just sent a bank e-confirmation saying wire in process for $18,720. DM'ed proof to Nora.

billing-bot: Payment monitor: incoming wire $18,720 for invoice 7812 received at 2026-03-20 09:03 UTC. Applied to invoice. Remaining balance: $43,680. Transaction ref: WIRE-2026-03-20-4492.

han_fin: Good. Nora, once addendum signed please move to "pending plan" and flag ledger with admin fee and a doubtful accounts note. Legal will finalize wording and keep a copy in contract repo.

legal-ops: Received signed addendum and PO amendment. Wording includes: pause-of-services clause, 1.5% admin fee, and collections trigger at >7 days late. No further redlines.

nora_collections: Marked account pending plan, removed from weekly escalation queue, set payment reminders for 05/01, 06/01, 07/01 for $14,560 each. Will update thread when payments post. :white_check_mark:

evan_sales: Thanks everyone. Sales will monitor integration timeline and only resume full onboarding when payments are current.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: next installment due 2026-05-01 for invoice 7812 1, scheduled amount $14,560."
